newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Bank Bali closes US$50 mln FRCD.
newsitem.headline: Bank Bali closes US$50 mln FRCD.

text.p: PT Bank Bali's US$50 million floating rate certificate of deposit issue has been allotted, arranger Arab Banking Corp said.
The facility has a final maturity of three years with no put or call options.
The issue was priced at par to float at 78 basis points over the six-month London Interbank Offered Rate.
With fees, the all-in return for top-tier managers is 92.5 basis points.
Arrangers, with US$4 million each, are Arab Banking Corp, United Overseas Bank and Sanwa International Finance.

Co-arrangers, with US$3 million each, are ABN Amro Bank, Banca Commerciale Intaliana, Bank of Nova Scotia Asia, Bayersiche Vereinsbank, LTCB Asia, Girocredit Bank, Gulf International Bank and Yasuda Trust & Banking.
Other co-arrangers with US$2 million each are BNP, Deutsche Morgan Grenfell and Merita Bank.
Co-lead managers, with US$1.5 million each, are Baden-wurttembergische Bank AG, Hua Nan Commercial Bank, Mitsubishi Trust Finance Asia and Toyo Trust & Banking.
Other co-lead managers, with US$1 million each, are Bank of Commerce (Labuan) and Tat Lee Bank.
